findings.fix: Add visible text inside the button element, such as <button id="project-settings-duplicate-btn" type="button">Duplicate</button>, or add an icon with alt text.
findings.location: Line 29, project settings section, duplicate button
findings.violation: The duplicate button contains no visible text, only an aria-label. Users relying on visual cues cannot understand the button's purpose without assistive technology.

findings.evidence: "Archiving \"Vendor Onboarding\"" and "\"Vendor Onboarding\" has been moved to archived projects"
findings.fix: Display the project name dynamically from the form input field rather than hardcoding it, or show a preview of the current name that updates when the input changes.

findings.violation: The project name is hardcoded in the confirmation dialogs, but line 26 shows the name can be edited in the input field. If a user changes the project name and then archives, the dialogs will still display the old name, creating confusion about which project is being archived.

findings.evidence: Form contains only <input type="email"> and <button type="submit">Save</button> with no status indicators
findings.fix: Add a success message or visual indicator (such as a green checkmark or "Saved" text) that appears after the Save button is clicked and before Continue is available.

findings.violation: The select dropdown does not visually indicate which frequency option is currently selected. Users cannot see their current notification setting before making a change.

findings.evidence: Import failed. Error code IMP-500. Contact support if this continues.
